package.description: WinBtrfs - an open-source btrfs driver for Windows

en-US.description: WinBtrfs - an open-source btrfs driver for Windows
en-US.longDescription: WinBtrfs is a Windows driver for the next-generation Linux filesystem Btrfs. A reimplementation from scratch, it contains no code from the Linux kernel, and should work on any version from Windows XP onwards. It is also included as part of the free operating system ReactOS.
en-US.name: WinBtrfs
